questiontext.text:
A small and large rectangular box arrive from an online delivery.


The small box has base area of \({@if integerp(smallBoxAreaDisp) then smallBoxAreaDisp else float(smallBoxAreaDisp)@}{@smallBoxAreaUnit@}\) and height of \({@if integerp(smallBoxHeightDisp) then smallBoxHeightDisp else float(smallBoxHeightDisp)@}{@smallBoxHeightUnit@}\).
The large box has dimensions \({@if integerp(largeBoxLengthDisp) then largeBoxLengthDisp else float(largeBoxLengthDisp)@}{@largeBoxLengthUnit@} \times {@if integerp(largeBoxWidthDisp) then largeBoxWidthDisp else float(largeBoxWidthDisp)@}{@largeBoxWidthUnit@} \times {@if integerp(largeBoxHeightDisp) then largeBoxHeightDisp else float(largeBoxHeightDisp)@}{@largeBoxHeightUnit@}\).


(a) What is the volume of the small box in \({@aUnits@}\)?

[[input:ans1]] \({@aUnits@}\) [[validation:ans1]]

(1)

[[feedback:prt1]]


(b) What is the total volume of the boxes in \({@bUnits@}\)?

[[input:ans2]] \({@bUnits@}\) [[validation:ans2]]

(2)

[[feedback:prt2]]


(c) What is the surface area of the large box in \({@cUnits@}\)?

[[input:ans3]] \({@cUnits@}\) [[validation:ans3]]

(2)

[[feedback:prt3]]

prtcorrect.text: Correct answer, well done.

prtpartiallycorrect.text: Your answer is partially correct.

prtincorrect.text: Incorrect answer.

truefeedback.text:
Here is a worked solution:

\(V_{small} = {@if integerp(smallBoxAreaDisp) then smallBoxAreaDisp else float(smallBoxAreaDisp)@}{@smallBoxAreaUnit@} \times {@if integerp(smallBoxHeightDisp) then smallBoxHeightDisp else float(smallBoxHeightDisp)@}{@smallBoxHeightUnit@}\)

\(V_{small} = {@if aUnits="m^3" then float(smallBoxArea/10000) else smallBoxArea@}{@if aUnits="m^3" then "m^2" else "{cm}^2"@} \times {@if aUnits="m^3" then float(smallBoxHeight/100) else smallBoxHeight@}{@if aUnits="m^3" then "m" else "cm"@}\)

\(V_{small} = {@if aUnits="m^3" then float((smallBoxArea/10000)*(smallBoxHeight/100)) else smallBoxArea*smallBoxHeight@}{@aUnits@}\)

\({@if integerp(node3_error) then node3_error else float(node3_error)@}{@if aUnits="m^3" then "{cm}^3" else "m^3"@}\) is the correct volume of the small box.
However, the you should have given the answer in \({@aUnits@}\).

You may have converted the area of the small box incorrectly.
Remember that \(1m^2 = 100^2{cm^2} = 10000{cm}^2\) and not \(100{cm}^2\).
So, \({@if integerp(smallBoxAreaDisp) then smallBoxAreaDisp else float(smallBoxAreaDisp)@}{@smallBoxAreaUnit@} = {@if aUnits="m^3" then float(smallBoxArea/10000) else smallBoxArea@}{@aUnits@}\).

Your answer is out by a magnitude of 10, which suggests you may have converted units incorrectly.
Here is a list of unit conversions:

\(1cm = 10mm\)

\(1m = 100cm = 1000mm\)

\(1m^2 = 10000{cm}^2\)

Here is a worked solution:

\(V_{small} = {@if aUnits="m^3" then float((smallBoxArea/10000)*(smallBoxHeight/100)) else smallBoxArea*smallBoxHeight@}{@aUnits@}\)

\(V_{small} = {@if aUnits="{cm}^3" then float((smallBoxArea/10000)*(smallBoxHeight/100)) else smallBoxArea*smallBoxHeight@}{@bUnits@}\)


\(V_{large} = {@if integerp(largeBoxLengthDisp) then largeBoxLengthDisp else float(largeBoxLengthDisp)@}{@largeBoxLengthUnit@} \times {@if integerp(largeBoxWidthDisp) then largeBoxWidthDisp else float(largeBoxWidthDisp)@}{@largeBoxWidthUnit@} \times {@if integerp(largeBoxHeightDisp) then largeBoxHeightDisp else float(largeBoxHeightDisp)@}{@largeBoxHeightUnit@}\)

\(V_{large} = {@if bUnits="m^3" then float(largeBoxLength/100) else largeBoxLength@}{@if bUnits="m^3" then "m" else "cm"@} \times {@if bUnits="m^3" then float(largeBoxWidth/100) else largeBoxWidth@}{@if bUnits="m^3" then "m" else "cm"@} \times {@if bUnits="m^3" then float(largeBoxHeight/100) else largeBoxHeight@}{@if bUnits="m^3" then "m" else "cm"@}\)

\(V_{large} = {@if bUnits="m^3" then float(largeBoxLength*largeBoxWidth*largeBoxHeight/1000000) else largeBoxLength*largeBoxWidth*largeBoxHeight@}{@bUnits@}\)


\(V_{total} = V_{small} + V_{large}\)

\(V_{total} = {@if aUnits="{cm}^3" then float((smallBoxArea/10000)*(smallBoxHeight/100)) else smallBoxArea*smallBoxHeight@}{@bUnits@} + {@if bUnits="m^3" then float(largeBoxLength*largeBoxWidth*largeBoxHeight/1000000) else largeBoxLength*largeBoxWidth*largeBoxHeight@}{@bUnits@}\)

\(V_{total} = {@if aUnits="{cm}^3" then float((smallBoxArea/10000)*(smallBoxHeight/100)+(largeBoxLength*largeBoxWidth*largeBoxHeight/1000000)) else (smallBoxArea*smallBoxHeight)+(largeBoxLength*largeBoxWidth*largeBoxHeight)@}{@bUnits@}\)

You have correctly calculated the volume of the large box as \({@if integerp((largeBoxLength*largeBoxWidth*largeBoxHeight)/(10^bUnitsExp)^3) then (largeBoxLength*largeBoxWidth*largeBoxHeight)/(10^bUnitsExp)^3 else float((largeBoxLength*largeBoxWidth*largeBoxHeight)/(10^bUnitsExp)^3)@}{@bUnits@}\).
However, your incorrect answer to (a) means that you have calculated the total volume incorrectly.

\({@if integerp(node4_error) then node4_error else float(node4_error)@}{@if bUnits="m^3" then "{cm}^3" else "m^3"@}\) is the correct total volume of the boxes.
However, the you should have given the answer in \({@bUnits@}\).

You have correctly calculated the volume of the large box as \({@if bUnits="m^3" then float((largeBoxLength*largeBoxWidth*largeBoxHeight)/(10^bUnitsExp)^3) else (largeBoxLength*largeBoxWidth*largeBoxHeight)/(10^bUnitsExp)^3@}{@bUnits@}\).
However, have converted the volume of the small box incorrectly from \({@aUnits@}\) to \({@bUnits@}\).
Remember, \(1m^3 = 100^3{cm}^3 = 1000000{cm}^3\).

The volume you appear to have calculated for the large box, \({@if bUnits="m^3" then ans2-ans1/1000000 else ans2-ans1*1000000@}{@bUnits@}\), is out by a magnitude of 10, which suggests you may have converted units incorrectly.
Here is a list of unit conversions:

\(1cm = 10mm\)

\(1m = 100cm = 1000mm\)

You have incorrectly converted the units for the volume of either the small box, large box or both into {@bUnits@}.


Here is a list of unit conversions:

\(1cm = 10mm\)

\(1m = 100cm = 1000mm\)

\(1m^3 = 100^3{cm}^3 = 1000000{cm}^3\)

Here is a worked solution:

\(A_{large} = 2 \times (({@if integerp(largeBoxLengthDisp) then largeBoxLengthDisp else float(largeBoxLengthDisp)@}{@largeBoxLengthUnit@} \times {@if integerp(largeBoxWidthDisp) then largeBoxWidthDisp else float(largeBoxWidthDisp)@}{@largeBoxWidthUnit@}) + ({@if integerp(largeBoxWidthDisp) then largeBoxWidthDisp else float(largeBoxWidthDisp)@}{@largeBoxWidthUnit@} \times {@if integerp(largeBoxHeightDisp) then largeBoxHeightDisp else float(largeBoxHeightDisp)@}{@largeBoxHeightUnit@}) + ({@if integerp(largeBoxHeightDisp) then largeBoxHeightDisp else float(largeBoxHeightDisp)@}{@largeBoxHeightUnit@} \times {@if integerp(largeBoxLengthDisp) then largeBoxLengthDisp else float(largeBoxLengthDisp)@}{@largeBoxLengthUnit@}))\)

\(A_{large} = 2 \times (({@if cUnits="m^2" then float(largeBoxLength/100) else largeBoxLength@}{@if cUnits="m^2" then "m" else "cm"@} \times {@if cUnits="m^2" then float(largeBoxWidth/100) else largeBoxWidth@}{@if cUnits="m^2" then "m" else "cm"@}) + ({@if cUnits="m^2" then float(largeBoxWidth/100) else largeBoxWidth@}{@if cUnits="m^2" then "m" else "cm"@} \times {@if cUnits="m^2" then float(largeBoxHeight/100) else largeBoxHeight@}{@if cUnits="m^2" then "m" else "cm"@}) + ({@if cUnits="m^2" then float(largeBoxHeight/100) else largeBoxHeight@}{@if cUnits="m^2" then "m" else "cm"@} + {@if cUnits="m^2" then float(largeBoxLength/100) else largeBoxLength@}{@if cUnits="m^2" then "m" else "cm"@}))\)

\(A_{large} = {@if integerp(cSol) then cSol else float(cSol)@}{@cUnits@}\)

\({@if integerp(node3_error) then node3_error else float(node3_error)@}{@if cUnits="m^2" then "{cm}^2" else "m^2"@}\) is the correct surface area of the large box.
However, the you should have given the answer in \({@cUnits@}\).
